topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes, learning objectives, and framing for cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Alterations
topics.groupedBecause: They discuss how genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications drive clonal fitness and progressive cellular transformation.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: They investigate the hierarchy of tissue differentiation and examine experimental evidence for cancer stem cells across different tissue types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how extrinsic microenvironmental signals, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma facilitate tumor outgrowth and progression.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: It details single-cell sequencing and spatial omics methods used to study cancer cell heterogeneity and tissue interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes the interplay among mutational burden, epigenetic plasticity, cell of origin, and microenvironmental factors in cancer progression.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides closing remarks for the session and previews the upcoming topic of cancer therapy.
